SubHub needs Android’s display-over-other-apps permission to show Popup Storm and its persistent stop control.
Enable Popup Storm and allow overlay access first.

Popup Storm spawns moving images at random screen positions, sometimes in quick bursts. If you have epilepsy, photosensitive seizures, migraines, or feel unwell from rapid visual changes, do not enable it.\n\nA persistent Stop Storm control remains above every popup. Android’s notification can also stop protection.
Overlay and notification access are ready.

1. Unlock Dom mode and enable the Censor, Limits, or Wallet areas you want.
2. Assign each app to Censor, Limit, or both.
3. Configure the enabled areas.
4. Return Home, choose the service duration, and tap Start Protection.
5. Hand over to Sub mode. Dom mode can review or release the setup with its PIN.

Display over other apps lets SubHub draw censors and safety controls. Accessibility powers App Mode, foreground-app assignment, visible-text geometry, taps, scrolling, and daily limits. Android 13+ notification access keeps protection status visible. Screen Capture is optional and Android asks for MediaProjection approval every session. Hardcore requests Device Admin separately; ordinary censoring never needs it.

Dom mode owns configuration: modules, rules, assigned apps, timers, PayPal, backups, and safety release. Sub mode is the operating view: start protection, see the active limits and Wallet balance, and use only the actions the Dom left available. Keep the Dom PIN private. Switching modes does not erase settings or stop an active service.

Start Protection begins the service and session. Choose 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or permanent service before starting. The selected duration defines the release boundary; Dom mode has the recovery release. After reboot, an active service lock can re-arm App Mode when Android allows it, but Screen Capture always needs fresh Android approval.

In Settings, mark each installed app Censor, Limit, both, or neither. Assigned-app recognition sleeps outside the selected apps. All-app recognition can censor whenever another app is foreground, but daily limits still apply only to apps marked Limit. Revisit assignment after installing, removing, or renaming apps.

Subliminal Messaging is an independent, on-device area. In Settings, enable it, choose Subliminal on each assigned app, then shape its voice and presence. While service is active, Accessibility places one faint, touch-through phrase at a safe random position and removes it smoothly. It never runs in SubHub, the keyboard, Android Settings, or an unassigned app. Only aggregate impression counts are stored; phrase history and screen content are not.

Filter rules select image categories, covered-content handling, explicit-text categories, phrase libraries, and custom phrases. Appearance controls the active censor style and its relevant color, motion, or image options. Higher detection levels inspect more often and can use more battery. Gallery Export creates censored copies on device; deleting selected originals always requires a separate confirmation.

Limits count foreground time only for apps marked Limit. Use a separate daily allowance for each app, one shared allowance across all limited apps, or both. Usage resets at local midnight. When either applicable allowance is exhausted, SubHub returns the limited app to Home. Limits require App Mode and Accessibility; Screen Capture alone cannot enforce foreground-app time.

Wallet is optional and local until checkout. Dom mode chooses the enabled events, prices, batching, grace/correction time, and daily and weekly caps. Manual checkout is payer-present. Saved-wallet auto-pay is separate, explicit, and runs only while Wallet, Hardcore Mode, an active service lock, and a verified saved PayPal wallet are all active. PayPal can still decline or require the payer to authorize again.

Use a PayPal Business account and create or select a REST app in the PayPal Developer Dashboard. Start with Sandbox credentials and a sandbox personal buyer; Live credentials are separate and move real money. Enable Save payment methods/Vault for the same app and complete PayPal’s business-profile eligibility step under Account Settings › Payment Preferences. In Dom Settings, choose the matching environment, connect its Client ID and secret, then Link Payer Wallet and approve the billing agreement in PayPal. Linking itself creates no charge. PayPal’s dashboard may label the eligible wallet capability “PayPal and Venmo”; Venmo is US-only and is not a German/EUR payment option.

Hardcore Mode is optional platform-supported friction. It asks for Device Admin, adds a deliberate Dom release before protected uninstall/data-clear paths, and can guard Android settings while service is active. It does not wipe data, set passwords, use the camera, force-lock the device, or make Android unbreakable. Confirm the Dom PIN and recovery path before handing over control.

If censors do not appear, open Permission Check and fix the next missing permission. Confirm the target app is assigned and the relevant module is enabled. If App Mode stalls, toggle SubHub off and on in Android Accessibility, then restart protection. Android secure windows may block capture. Diagnostics shows service state, detector, frame rate, latency, and recent errors. For PayPal, confirm the selected environment matches the app credentials and that the saved-wallet status is Ready.

Image and text detection run on this device. Screen snapshots are processed in memory and are not saved. App assignments, rules, statistics, profiles, packs, diagnostics, and Wallet history stay local unless you explicitly export them. PayPal credentials and saved-wallet IDs are encrypted with Android Keystore; OAuth, checkout, wallet authorization, and fraud-risk data go directly to PayPal.

Studio creates portable .subhubpack arrangements for SubHub’s client-side features. Start blank, capture the current setup, add feature sections and private image assets, then keep a draft, add it to the Library, or share it through Android. Dom Space reviews sections before activation and can lock feature groups until deactivation. Ordinary matching active-arrangement updates remain available in Sub Space. Dom Space can explicitly attach PayPal merchant credentials and a recipient link encrypted with a separate passphrase. Only trusted recipients should receive that secret; their app can read it after unlocking. No payer authorization, verification, or payment history is transferred. Encrypted PayPal updates require deactivation and a fresh Dom review. Security and duration choices are recommendations only: packs never enable Android access, start service, change the controller PIN, or import app assignments. Legacy .bbpack files remain import-only.

Open Manage Updates below to check SubHub’s public GitHub releases. SubHub selects the smaller APK for this device, verifies its hash, package, version, and signing certificate, then hands it to Android for final approval. Automatic checks include stable and preview builds; downloads never start without your tap.
